Services.title: A comprehensive range
Services.subtitle: of financial services
Services.savingsDesc: Secure your funds with our various savings plans tailored to your projects.
Services.loansDesc: Grow your agricultural or commercial activities with our flexible loans.
Services.transfersDesc: Send and receive money safely anywhere in Togo and internationally.

Impact.title: Our Impact since 2002
Impact.desc: Concrete results that testify to our daily commitment to Togo's economic development and the financial inclusion of our communities.

About.title: A major player in microfinance in Togo
About.desc1: For over two decades, SPEC OIC-Togo has supported economic actors in the formal and informal sectors. Born from the NGO OIC-Togo, our institution has established itself as a trusted partner for thousands of rural and urban households.
About.desc2: Our network extends across the Plateaux and Centrale regions, with the main mission of continuously improving our members' living conditions through tailored, accessible, and innovative financial services.

Network.title: Our Network
Network.desc: 3 branches and 13 counters to serve you as closely as possible in the Plateaux and Centrale regions.

Testimonials.title: They <blue>Trust</blue> Us
Testimonials.desc: Discover how SPEC OIC-Togo supports the development of its members.
Testimonials.quote1: Thanks to SPEC OIC-Togo's commercial loan, I tripled my shop's stock in less than two years. Their support helped me manage my finances better and grow my business.
Testimonials.quote2: The agricultural loan and SPEC's support transformed my farm. Today, I produce more and secure my family's income for the whole year.
Testimonials.quote3: I started with a small savings of 5,000 FCFA. The trust SPEC placed in me allowed me to open my own sewing workshop and employ two apprentices.

CTA.title: Ready to build your future?
CTA.desc: Join a solid institution that puts people at the center of its financial priorities.

Footer.desc: Savings and Credit Promotion Structure, born from OIC-Togo (PARAT program). Serving financial inclusion in Togo since October 17, 2002.

OpenAccount.title: Open an Account
OpenAccount.subtitle: Join over 64,000 Togolese who trust SPEC OIC. Review the requirements below and leave us your contact details — an advisor will call you back quickly to finalize.
OpenAccount.indiv1: Copy of valid National ID Card or Passport
OpenAccount.indiv3: Proof of address (CEET/TdE bill less than 3 months old)
OpenAccount.formSubtitle: Fill out this form and our team will contact you within 24 business hours to prepare your file before your visit to the branch.
OpenAccount.successDesc: An advisor will call you back very soon to finalize your account opening.
OpenAccount.cta: Have an advisor call me back
